# sigma_teams (Data Source)

List all teams in the Sigma organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All teams in the org.
data "sigma_teams" "all" {}

output "team_names" {
  value = [for t in data.sigma_teams.all.teams : t.name]
}
```
